conviction_note: Q3 should beat the plan's implied run-rate. The base is easy (Q3 2025 same-store sales 103.8% against 108.5% in Q2), and the November 2025 price rise and the April buffet renewal are still lifting average spend. But a Q3 forecast revision would break the company's record, the stock sits at an all-time high 23% above its pre-Q2 price and above Tokai Tokyo's 2,800 target, and its last two beats were bought only +0.12% and +2.29%. The positive quarter and the 'good news is out' risk roughly offset, so p_up is 49 on a 3.3% scale and the findings sum to 0.0. The two measurements agree.
bar: Company plan revised 2026-07-22: FY OP 3,970m, H2 OP 2,040m, H2 sales 17,525m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260721597038.pdf; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260721597065.pdf). The plan-implied Q3 OP is about 997m if H2 splits the way 2025 did (833/1,705). No IFIS or 四季報 number could be sourced, so the street bar is unsourced and every size is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is my Q3 OP estimate (~1,040-1,060m) against that implied 997m.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-10-21: 0.78% from one seller, down from 0.82%, so shorts are covering slightly (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 is 0.82: the margin short side is bigger than the margin long side, which is squeeze fuel rather than a crowded long. There are no options, so there is no skew. The baseline's priced_lean_pct is +0.315. The stock made new highs on 2026-10-20 in a restaurant-sector rally on talk of support measures that would come with the food consumption tax cut (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3091&b=n202610200583).

findings.finding: Q3 (Jul-Sep) laps an easy base: same-store sales were 103.8% in Q3 2025 (Jul 102.2, Aug 107.1, Sep 101.6) against 108.5% in Q2 2025. Average spend is still carried by the November 2025 price rise, and the H1 2026 operating margin was 11.7%. Q2 operating profit grew +29.8% while the H2 plan needs only +19.7%, so Q3 OP is likely ~1,040-1,060m against a plan-implied ~1,000m, and 9-month progress lands around 75% against 70.2% at the same point in 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 OP +93.5% beat, released 2026-04-21 15:30: +0.12% next session, then -3.80%. Q2 2026 beat plus upgrade, 2026-07-22: +2.29% (FISCO: 'upside was expected, reaction limited'). Q3 2025 9-month OP 10.9% below the internal plan, 2025-10-21: -1.95%. Close-to-close from Yahoo daily bars.
findings.why_not_priced: Bronco Billy publishes no monthly sales. Same-store comps appear only in the quarterly 参考資料, so Jul-Sep demand is unseen until today. Partly offsetting: the stock is already at an all-time high, which suggests a decent quarter is expected. If the beat were fully priced, the stock would not be trading only ~34x the revised EPS while the plan implies H2 growth well below the H1 pace.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 参考資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260721597065.pdf) for H1 comps 107.7% and the H2 plan. JF industry data for August 2026 (https://www.jfnet.or.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/getujidata-2026-8.pdf): family restaurants 103.7%, western-style FR 105.5%, but yakiniku only 101.2% and weak late in the month. That is a proxy and mixed. Caution from the same company document: June 2026 customer count was 92.5% (comps 102.0%).

findings.finding: A forecast revision at Q3 is unlikely: kabutan's revision record shows the company revised only at Q2 in 2023, 2024 and 2026, never at Q3. The stock trades at 2,950, above Tokai Tokyo's raised 2,800 target (2026-08-13) and about 23% above its 2,398 pre-Q2 close. So a beat with the plan held risks a sell-the-news (出尽くし) reaction, as Q1 2026 showed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026, plan held with a strong beat: +0.12% then -3.80% (FISCO 2026-04-22: 'short-term sense of news being out'). FY2025 print with a flat-ish new guide (OP +1%): -3.16% on 2026-01-21.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the run-up and the sector-policy rally are visible to everyone. What is not obviously in the price is that holders who bought the new highs may want a second upgrade the company has never given at Q3. A market that expected a hold would not have bid the stock above the sell-side target into the print.

baseline_tension: Positioning leans mildly positive (margin ratio 0.82, shorts covering, priced_lean +0.315) and the 20-day run-up is +5.5%. The strongest positive the release could carry is a Q3 beat above the H2 run-rate, which I looked for and filed as finding 1. A Q3 upgrade or dividend action would be a bigger positive but is against the company's record. The findings net to zero, so neither the positioning nor the run-up is contradicted.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 / open question 4: the negative rests on public information (the revision record, the run-up) and a run-in short read was wrong once already, so finding 2 goes from -0.8 to -0.5 and p_up from 48 to 49.
Rule 2: I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and had already looked for it (finding 1, no Q3 dividend or buyback history); no further change.
